title: Few and Far Between
description: Ingun Black-Briar, an aspiring alchemist practicing at Elgrim's Elixirs in Riften, has depleted Master Elgrim's rare ingredient stores with her errant formulas. She asks the player to gather 20 deathbell, 20 nirnroot, and 20 nightshade to restore the stock, offering leveled gold and her supply chest key as reward.

base_facts: I am an aspiring alchemist practicing at Elgrim's Elixirs in Riften.
I am the black sheep of the Black-Briar family; my brother Sibbi handles the family business.
My errant formulas have cost Master Elgrim a fortune in rare ingredients.
I need 20 deathbell, 20 nirnroot, and 20 nightshade to restore Elgrim's stock.

INGUN_ALCHEMY_TALK: I have explained to the player that I need rare ingredients to restore Master Elgrim's supply.
ACCEPT_INGREDIENT_QUEST: The player has agreed to gather the rare ingredients I need.
RETURN_WITH_INGREDIENTS: The player has gathered the ingredients and returned to speak with me.
DELIVER_ALL_INGREDIENTS: I have given the player my supply chest key and leveled gold; Master Elgrim will be pleased I've restored his stock of rare ingredients used for powerful poisons.
The player is welcome to take what they need from my supply chest at the back of Elgrim's Elixirs; I will restock it with 2-5 random leveled potions every few days.
The key I provided will be needed each time the chest resets; I will remind the player to check the supply chest whenever we part ways.
My disposition toward the player has increased for their diligence in gathering the rare ingredients I needed.

beats.comment: Player asks Ingun about alchemy and learns she needs ingredients.
Player agrees to gather the rare ingredients for Ingun, starting the quest.
Player has collected ingredients and the quest advances to speak with Ingun.
Player delivers the last of the ingredients and receives the supply chest key and gold.
